retrieval_pass_rate.definition: Proportion of queries that retrieved >0 candidates and deep-dived >0 papers (for standard queries) or successfully retrieved and triaged off-target candidates to 0 deep dives (for implausible queries).

claim_grounding_precision.definition: Proportion of evidence ledger claims that are verbatim contained in cited text AND semantically relevant to query exposure/outcome (excluding off-target extractions like diabetes for cataract query).

strict_relationship_classification_accur.definition: Proportion of queries where end-to-end synthesized relationship strictly matches independent literature ground truth (no partial credit).

retrieval_conditioned_relationship_accur.definition: Relationship classification accuracy evaluated ONLY on the subset of queries where the system successfully extracted >=1 finding into the evidence ledger (15 queries).

abstention_accuracy.definition: Proportion of queries avoiding false confidence (no SUPPORTED subclaims on implausible folklore or insufficient evidence).

summary_consistency_rate.definition: Proportion of queries where executive summary bottom line and overall assessment strictly align with subclaim assessments and evidence ledger.

runner_metric_audit.explanation: The runner reported 69.2% by granting partial credit: 0.5 for inconclusive/unresolved on missing literature, 0.75 for qualified/supported matches, and 0.25 for directional mismatches. True strict binary match is 43.3% (13/30).
